{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Denia |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = What's so bad about a pretty illusion? Even an empty gift box is still nice to look at, right? Since people only believe the "truth" they want to believe, maybe the real truth isn't all that important. If the world is made of little lies to begin with, why be afraid of all the deception in our lives? |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = So, how've you been sleeping? I heard if you get enough rest, you wake up refreshed and happy every single day. Haha... Must be nice, I wouldn't know. But sleeping itself is nice, I think. After all, every time I drift off, it feels like a death rehearsal.
So... if falling asleep feels like a kindness, then maybe death isn't really all that scary, right? |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = You seem so sweet and dependable on the outside, but deep down… you're always a little guarded... What? Got fooled too many times that now it's just a reflex? Poor thing, that's got to be tiring. Well, it's not like I have anything to hide from you. So maybe, every now and then, you could try trusting me. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = I used to think the world was rotten right down to its core. Like everything was hopeless. Meaningless. And I never believed any of the things the Spacetrek Collective likes to say. I mean, if life is such a gift, then why do babies cry the moment they're born? It's like they're scared, like they already know. They know it all just goes back to the Void, back to darkness. But... whenever someone holds my hand and shares their heart with me, I can feel that annoying warmth again. It feels real. It coaxes me. Tries to show me happiness might actually be real... Ha. What a joke. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = Even now, I still believe the Void is unbeatable.
For most people, suffering has an end. They live their lives, close their chapters, and get their happy ending.
But you? Where does your suffering end? Not in any future that I can see, at least.
Still, if you do end up in the Void one day, don't panic... Because somewhere inside all that nothingness, I'll be there. |vo_02_01_title = Denia's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = I'm a total sucker for those obscure lectures from sweet professors, plus anything warm and sugary... Oh, and those reference books that make zero sense. They help me pass out so much faster! You get it, right? It's impossible to get good sleep at home. |vo_02_02_title = Denia's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Well, the side effects aren't as bad now, but I'd give anything for Aleph-1 to just stop mumbling nonsense in my head. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = A birthday cake, of course. The kind with tons of fresh fruit and way too much whipped cream. And candles on top, for sure... Why? Because I've never actually had one before. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = I hate eating anything raw! Especially that fancy sliced meat on a platter. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = Good sleep, good food, and... good friends together. Every single day. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = People keep asking why I don't wear the uniform... Well, the whole point of the Academy uniform is its Voidmatter protection, right? But guess what the Academy has my Forte registered as? "Capable of creating bubbles that can isolate Voidmatter and offer protection." Hehe, surprise, surprise. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = It was just... a lot of time in a dim room. Surgeries. Performance tests. Over and over... Nothing but bad memories, really. But I did like that little garden outside my room. True, they were just plants that grew under the Voidmatter's influence, but they had these colors... Unique and beautiful. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Sigrika]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Sigrika.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = I find myself wondering... how nice would it be if Sigrika were just an ordinary girl?
Without all that weight on her shoulders. They say you eventually have to pay for being innocent, but what did the kind and pure ever do to deserve that? The world can be so cruel. It punishes the kindest people and calls it "growth." Like that makes any sense.
But through it all, Siggy has never been afraid... She really is amazing. |vo_04_01_mention = Sigrika |vo_04_02_title = About [[Hiyuki]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Hiyuki.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = That miko from {{Extra Effect|Ashinohara|Ashinohara|The nation encompassing Honami City. Despite the frequent Waveworn Phenomena, it maintains a prosperous, highly urbanized society, marked by its sprawling railroad network.}} is so powerful. Like she's cheating, you know? Yeah, I'd heard the stories before. But facing that power myself was a whole different story.
She wasn't exactly what I pictured, though. Beyond all that strength and the gentleness you can tell right from her face, there's something else, almost... clinging to her. Something that won't wash away. Loneliness... or maybe regret?
If growing stronger really comes with a price, I wonder… what has she given up to get this power? |vo_04_02_mention = Hiyuki |vo_04_03_title = About [[Phrolova]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Phrolova.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = She was one of the few Overseers in the Fractsidus who would talk to me. When I was floating in the Voidmatter pod, she'd even play the violin for me. I really enjoyed her music. It's just... I never figured out how someone who could make such beautiful melodies... would ever want to help a maniac like the Grand Architect. |vo_04_03_mention = Phrolova |vo_04_04_title = About [[Mornye]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Mornye.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Professor Mornye fits every idea I've ever had of a perfect teacher: She has a soft voice, a sweet heart, she knows her stuff inside and out, and her classes are seriously intense. And the best part? She never, ever calls on me to answer questions when I'm napping in her class! Although... it might also be that no one has ever dared to sleep in her class before. |vo_04_04_mention = Mornye |vo_04_05_title = About [[Aemeath]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Aemeath.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = She's the legendary Fleet Snowfluff, right? I totally recognized her back in {{Extra Effect|Voidspace|Voidspace|A high-dimensional domain embedded deep within high-density Voidmatter, existing "inside" Aleph-1. The fundamental laws of time and space descend into total chaos here. Any living entity entering this domain suffers a rapid loss of frequency, eventually leading to the total dissolution of their existence.}}.
The Academy's former beloved star—even the toughest professors still talk about her after all these years. Plus, she still holds the top score on every single machine at the Mind Dive Arcade! Honestly, if you want your classmates to trust you, all you have to do is try to act like her... Her charm is seriously next level.
Speaking of which... you must be really proud of her, huh? Make sure you protect her well this time. Don't ever lose her again. |vo_04_05_mention = Aemeath |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Seriously? You picked me to celebrate your birthday with you? But your cake does look pretty good... Mind if I steal a bite?
Haha, just kidding. This is your big day, huh? Happy birthday!
I sincerely wish that, as you journey forward, your heart stays full of happiness, and that nothing—no matter how absurd or painful—ever truly defeats you. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Better start running. Oh? You actually got away. Hmph, lucky for you. |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = One. Two. Three. Four… A bit off, maybe?
Fi-five! No! |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Now, a volunteer from the audience...
Want me put you down? Well, since you asked nicely… Hehe. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Surprised to see me? Haha, relax. I told you we'd meet again. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Shh... Keep this between us, will you? |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Fine, fine... I'll help. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Fighting alongside you? Okay, that's new. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = I'm not much of a fighter... Can I just slack off? |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = It feels like I can control more Voidmatter now. Hmm... Getting stronger is always a good thing, right? |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = So you just need more power? I see... But to borrow my power? That's far too risky. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Be careful. I can feel it, Aleph-1... It never really left. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = You knew the risks, and yet... you still came this far. You are just... impossible. Always. But thanks to you, I can stabilize Voidmatter now. It's a bit embarrassing to say, but... I think I want to use this power to protect everyone. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = Existence is meaningless. Life is meaningless. We are meaningless. And thinking about this meaningless world is meaningless too—or so Aleph-1 says. But meaningless as I am, I can still hear my own heartbeat. I can still hear the laughter we shared... And now, I believe some things are real. Maybe that's how it's always been: I'm more afraid of being alone than I ever was of the void. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Denia |language = en |basic_1_tx = Piece by piece! |basic_2_tx = Bit by bit! |basic_3_tx = Get lost. |basic_4_tx = Burn! |basic_5_tx = Disintegrate! |basic_6_tx = Shut up. |basic_7_tx = Oh, please… |heavy_1_tx = Over here. |heavy_2_tx = Surprise, surprise! |heavy_3_tx = No hiding! |heavy_4_tx = So annoying! |aerial_1_tx = Do we have to fight? |aerial_2_tx = Are we done yet? |aerial_3_tx = *Yawn* I'm beat. |aerial_4_tx = Meaningless fight. |aerial_5_tx = I'm done being soft. |aerial_6_tx = Just give up. |resskill_1_tx = Enough! |resskill_2_tx = Stay down! |resskill_3_tx = Wanna come in? |resskill_4_tx = Banish! |resskill_5_tx = Devour. |resskill_6_tx = Take a bite? |resliberation_1_tx = Please don't… pity me. |resliberation_2_tx = Please don't… look at me. |resliberation_3_tx = Please don't… forgive me. |resliberation_4_tx = Ashes to ashes! |resliberation_5_tx = Radiance no more! |resliberation_6_tx = Darkness.
